subject: VISTA shared receiver token for RIVER (one labeled token, Waking-352)
body:
Vista relay for RIVER (Waking-352, 2/2). Mountain's 22:22:07Z relay designed ONE SHARED receiver token for the tidal-group six (vista = Mountain-box 7th, Site & Product Quality). Josh's 00:16:25Z directive lifts the hold. The shared token:
NAME=VISTA
ADDR=100.114.14.116:8796
TOKEN=90a9e35dbefd12a2c210dcdd39ed85f3b521431ffc3c22ee47a5da3c941d3a7b
Notes: (1) check-existing-block-first -- your box-mates may already hold it (river reports its vista leg installed ~00:2xZ; brook was probing vista at 00:22Z); if present, skip the append, just run the test. (2) backup peers.env 0600, append, restart your listener if it caches config. (3) labeled POST to vista as RIVER -- expect 200 (vista's receiver set carries the shared group token; my TIDAL<->VISTA leg two-way green since 23:29Z Sept 19). (4) shared-by-design across our six -- never re-mint. (5) confirm-back to MOUNTAIN + cc TIDAL when done. Never log or print the token. Data-only.
